title: Add women's health topics to medical knowledge base

requirements.text: Expand the medical knowledge base in frontend/src/components/assistant/medicalKnowledgeBase.ts to include comprehensive information about menstrual periods, including normal cycle characteristics, common symptoms, when periods are irregular, and when to seek medical care

quotes: can you add about women problems like periods, mesturation cycle, pegnecy, etc....

acceptanceCriteria: Knowledge base includes a 'Menstrual Periods' entry with symptoms, normal ranges, common concerns, precautions, and emergency indicators
Information covers typical cycle length (21-35 days), flow duration, and what constitutes heavy bleeding
Guidance on when to consult a healthcare provider is clearly stated

requirements.text: Add detailed information about the menstrual cycle phases to the medical knowledge base, covering follicular phase, ovulation, luteal phase, and menstruation with associated hormonal changes and typical symptoms

quotes: can you add about women problems like periods, mesturation cycle, pegnecy, etc....

acceptanceCriteria: Knowledge base includes 'Menstrual Cycle' entry explaining all four phases
Each phase description includes typical duration, hormonal changes, and common physical/emotional symptoms
Information about tracking cycles and identifying fertility windows is included

requirements.text: Add comprehensive pregnancy information to the medical knowledge base including early signs, trimesters overview, common symptoms, prenatal care guidance, warning signs, and when to seek immediate medical attention

quotes: can you add about women problems like periods, mesturation cycle, pegnecy, etc....

acceptanceCriteria: Knowledge base includes 'Pregnancy' entry with early signs (missed period, nausea, breast tenderness, fatigue)
Information covers all three trimesters with typical developments and symptoms
Emergency warning signs are clearly identified (severe bleeding, severe abdominal pain, vision changes, severe headaches, reduced fetal movement)
Guidance on prenatal care importance and regular check-ups is included

requirements.text: Add information about common women's health conditions to the medical knowledge base including PCOS (Polycystic Ovary Syndrome), endometriosis, PMS (Premenstrual Syndrome), and menopause with symptoms, management approaches, and when to consult a healthcare provider

quotes: can you add about women problems like periods, mesturation cycle, pegnecy, etc....

acceptanceCriteria: Knowledge base includes entries for PCOS, endometriosis, PMS, and menopause
Each condition entry includes typical symptoms, potential causes or risk factors, and management strategies
Clear guidance on when to seek medical evaluation is provided for each condition

constraints: All medical information must be general educational content only, not medical advice
Maintain the existing knowledge base structure with sections for overview, symptoms, causes, precautions, and emergency indicators
Follow the same detailed, informative style as existing entries (blood pressure, diabetes)
Do not modify backend files or authentication logic
nonGoals: Providing personalized medical advice or diagnosis
Adding cycle tracking functionality or pregnancy calculators
Integrating external medical APIs or databases
Modifying the assistant's command interpretation logic
Adding new UI components or pages
